zaihua_news/3357.title: USTC builds structure-guided RNA foundation model published in Nature
paragraphs: A team from the University of Science and Technology of China has introduced structRFM, a structure-guided RNA foundation model. The paper was published online in Nature on November 5. The model incorporates base-pairing information from secondary structures into sequence pretraining, trained on about 21 million paired sequence–structure examples, and achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple tasks.

The team also developed MUSES, a method that combines predictions from multiple secondary-structure predictors to reduce bias. Its 3D structure prediction module, Zfold, performs on par with AlphaFold 3. The data, weights, and code have all been made publicly available.
中国科大新闻网 | Nature
zh_parts: 中国科大构建结构引导的 RNA 基础模型并发表于《自然》
中国科学技术大学的一个团队推出了结构引导的 RNA 基础模型 structRFM。该论文于 11 月 5 日在线发表在《自然》杂志上。该模型将来自二级结构的碱基配对信息纳入序列预训练中，在约 2100 万对序列-结构示例上进行训练，并在多项任务上取得了先进的性能。
该团队还开发了 MUSES，这是一种结合多个二级结构预测器预测结果以减少偏差的方法。其 3D 结构预测模块 Zfold 的表现与 AlphaFold 3 相当。数据、权重和代码均已公开。

zaihua_news/3358.title: Node.js to Release Security Updates for Three Release Lines After November 11
paragraphs: Node.js has announced upcoming security updates: new versions of the 22, 24, and 26 release lines will be released on or shortly after November 11, 2026, to fix security vulnerabilities. The highest severity rating addressed in this release is HIGH.
Node.js(@nodejs) | Node.js

zaihua_news/3359.title: A wealthy Indian bets on homegrown satellite internet, takes on SpaceX
paragraphs: Indian billionaire Sunil Mittal says the Eutelsat backed OneWeb plans to build a global satellite internet network independent of the US and China, competing with SpaceX’s Starlink.

Starlink has more than 10,000 satellites in orbit and at least 13.6 million users in the September quarter, with connectivity revenue topping $5 billion. OneWeb has about 650 satellites, and its low Earth orbit revenue for the same period was just €70.9 million. Mittal says OneWeb has been awaiting approval in India for years and is first in the queue.
Bloomberg

zaihua_news/3360.title: 华尔街 Daily: Rising Memory Chip Prices Could Actually Boost Apple’s iPhone Profits
paragraphs: 华尔街 Daily estimates that upgrading the iPhone 18 Pro from 256 GB to 1 TB costs an extra $600, while the additional flash memory costs about $192. That leaves Apple with $408 more in profit, a 300% margin. The equivalent upgrade on the previous-generation iPhone 17 Pro cost an extra $400, while the additional memory cost just $42.

Apple has acknowledged that rising memory chip prices are squeezing its gross margin. However, analysts estimate that its flash memory purchases will cost about $25 billion in 2026, and its gross margin may fall by only one percentage point.
Blue Dot Network

zaihua_news/3361.title: Microsoft: High memory usage in Windows 11 isn’t a problem
paragraphs: Microsoft Windows chief Pavan Davuluri says that seeing memory usage at 70% or even 90% in Task Manager doesn’t mean you’re running out of memory: Windows caches apps and data you might use, then frees up space when needed.

In a November 3 blog post, he compared memory to a desk and an SSD to a drawer, saying, “The real test is whether your computer stays responsive.” New tuning for 8 GB devices can keep up to 2 GB more active data in memory.
Windows Latest

zaihua_news/3362.title: Italian chef fired for refusing to make pineapple pizza loses appeal
paragraphs: Italian chef Davide Tamburella was fired from Brisbane’s La Costa restaurant in May this year after refusing to put pineapple on a pizza. He lodged an unfair dismissal claim with Australia’s Fair Work Commission, but it was rejected.

The ruling said he considered putting pineapple on pizza “an insult to Italian culture” and had refused to use the fruit three times over four years; the commission rejected the claim on the grounds that it was submitted too late. The restaurant said the matter was not just about pizza toppings.
BBC News

zaihua_news/3363.title: 2027 holiday schedule released: fewest make-up workdays in recent years
paragraphs:
The 2027 holiday schedule was announced on November 5: the Spring Festival holiday runs from February 5 (Lunar New Year's Eve) to 13 (the eighth day of the first lunar month), totaling 9 days with adjusted days off, matching 2026 as the longest Spring Festival break ever; to avoid seven consecutive workdays after the holiday, one day is shifted from each of the two weekends before and after Spring Festival.
New Year's Day and Qingming naturally connect with weekends with no make-up days, while Dragon Boat Festival and Mid-Autumn Festival both fall on Wednesday with no make-up days. For the year: Spring Festival 9 days, National Day 7 days, Labor Day 5 days, New Year's Day and Qingming 3 days each; the longest consecutive stretch of work after a holiday is 6 days, and the number of make-up workdays is the lowest in recent years.
CCTV News

zaihua_news/3364.title: China blocks SoftBank’s $5.4 billion acquisition of ABB’s robotics business
paragraphs: Chinese regulators have blocked SoftBank Group’s roughly $5.4 billion acquisition of the robotics business of Swiss industrial giant ABB. ABB confirmed on Nov. 5 that it had received notice from China’s foreign investment security review authority prohibiting the transaction from being implemented in China, throwing a wrench into SoftBank’s plans to build out its artificial intelligence and robotics businesses.

Chinese regulators are concerned that industrial data, supply chains and core technologies involved in ABB’s robotics business could be transferred overseas and used to train AI models. China accounts for about 30% of ABB’s robotics business and is an important market. The block also reflects China’s tightened scrutiny of foreign acquisitions in strategic technology sectors, after Meta’s acquisition of AI startup Manus encountered similar obstacles.
Bloomberg

zaihua_news/3365.title: Micron halts construction on $4.5 billion Taoyuan plant amid labor dispute
paragraphs: Micron has suspended construction of its $4.5 billion memory chip plant in Taoyuan, Taiwan, and notified Taiwanese officials and suppliers, according to people familiar with the matter. Executives are concerned that an agreement with a local union could be overturned. The plant was scheduled to begin operations in 2028.

Micron said Taiwan is important to its global footprint and that its existing operations are running normally. Taiwan accounts for about 60% of Micron’s DRAM output. The Taoyuan union is demanding that 15% of operating profits be shared with employees worldwide and is seeking to overturn an agreement reached with the Taichung union.
Bloomberg

zaihua_news/3366.title: C. Ronaldo officially announces his retirement from Portugal duty, bringing his 23-year international career to a close
paragraphs: The 41-year-old Portuguese football icon Cristiano Ronaldo (C. Ronaldo) has announced that he will officially retire from the Portugal national team after the November international break, ending a 23-year international career. He said the decision was both difficult and deeply moving, and that he would be saying goodbye to the No. 7 shirt that had been with him for many years.

Ronaldo made 234 appearances for Portugal and scored 146 goals, setting men’s international football records in both categories. He led Portugal to the 2016 European Championship title and won the UEFA Nations League twice. His farewell also marks the end of an era for a generation of football legends.
FITA

zaihua_news/3367.title: Hydrogen chloride detected above a Martian fissure, possibly indicating ongoing volcanic activity
paragraphs: The European-Russian ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter detected hydrogen chloride in the lower atmosphere above surface fissures in Mars’s Alba Mons region. The research team believes volcanic outgassing is the most likely source. The findings have been published in Science Advances.

The gas peaks in early summer each year, possibly because melting ice inside the fissures allows underground magmatic gases to escape. If a heat source from magma remains underground, it could create hydrothermal environments suitable for microbial life.
Wausau, Stevens Point

zaihua_news/3368.title: Study: Teens worldwide meet physical activity guidelines on an average of just 2.7 days a week
paragraphs: A study of more than 3.2 million adolescents across 140 countries and territories, published in The Lancet Global Health, found that participants met the 60-minute daily physical activity recommendation on an average of just 2.7 days a week. Only 14% met it all seven days.

The gap was marked for girls: 28% had not met the recommendation on any day in the past week, compared with 22% of boys. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said there had been little progress in the past 15 years and called for schools, streets and communities to provide safer, more accessible spaces for physical activity.
UN News

zaihua_news/3369.title: Huawei Cloud to Launch openPangu-2.1-Pro on November 15
paragraphs: According to market sources, Huawei 云 MaaS platform will officially update and launch the openPangu-2.1-Pro flagship model on November 15, with current users notified by text message. This version focuses on improving code generation quality for the ArkTS language in native HarmonyOS app development.

The update also covers core products including the AgentArts agent platform, 码道 CodeArts, and 果办 OfficeAce, which will all gain access to the flagship model. Previous claims that Huawei Cloud had completely discontinued its Pangu large language models were based on an outside misunderstanding.
格隆汇

zaihua_news/3370.title: Switch 2 Sales Fall 41% Year Over Year in Second Fiscal Quarter
paragraphs: Nintendo reported sales of just 2.67 million Switch 2 consoles in the second fiscal quarter ended September 30, down 41% year over year and well below the 3.82 million sold in the previous quarter. Rising memory chip prices have pushed up costs, and Nintendo has raised prices in several markets. Revenue came to 448.2 billion yen and net profit to 73.5 billion yen, both below market expectations.

The company maintained its sales target of 16.5 million units for the fiscal year ending March 2027. The market is counting on the remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, launching Thursday, to drive sales in the months ahead.
财联社

zaihua_news/3371.title: About 600,000 Nvidia H200 chips are stockpiled in Hong Kong awaiting approval
paragraphs: Reuters, citing people familiar with the matter, reported that about 600,000 Nvidia H200 chips are stockpiled in Hong Kong, awaiting shipment to mainland China because Beijing has yet to approve large-scale imports. In recent months, a small number of Chinese internet companies each received about 10,000 chips, while a limited quantity also entered through intermediaries and indirect channels.

The H200 is not Nvidia’s latest model, but it still outperforms domestic alternatives. In late October, an eight-GPU H200 server in mainland China was quoted at more than 6 million yuan, about three times the price a year earlier.
Reuters

zaihua_news/3372.title: DeepSeek Harness Daily Active Users Reach 1.54 Million, with Over 35,000 Plugins
paragraphs: DeepSeek Harness officials disclosed that as of November 4, the platform had 1.54 million daily active users and daily token consumption of 92.1 trillion. The platform now has nearly 35,000 third-party plugins, and about 60% of active users have used or developed plugins.

Looking ahead, the company announced plans to improve plugin API stability, build an official plugin marketplace to better connect supply and demand, and launch a “Creator Support Program” offering token incentives, featured projects, and business partnerships with enterprises. The company said its long-term vision is to make the product “the operating system for the Agent era,” providing foundational capabilities through a thriving plugin ecosystem to meet users’ personalized needs.
DeepSeek Harness

zaihua_news/3375.title: Chip stock selloff deepens, Nasdaq 100 falls 5%
paragraphs: The US chip sector selloff deepened on November 4, with the Nasdaq 100 down 5% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index falling 36% from its June peak. Nvidia dropped 7.9%, while Qualcomm and Arm slid after issuing weaker-than-expected guidance. Tesla and SpaceX both fell about 10%.

Investors are weighing the prospect of increased regulation of the AI trade after Democrats swept Congress. Funds shifted to defensive sectors such as consumer staples and healthcare, while US Treasuries, the yen and the Swiss franc strengthened. Bitcoin fell 5%.
Bloomberg

zaihua_news/3376.title: OpenSSH 紧急修复 Alpine 长密码绕过认证漏洞
paragraphs: OpenSSH Version 10.6p2 was released on November 5, urgently fixing a vulnerability that allowed SSH authentication to be bypassed with passwords 257 to 1,024 bytes long. On Alpine Linux, an attacker could use it to log in to accounts with passwordless keys, provided they have network access to the server and know the account name.

Alpine has released patched packages for versions 3.16 and later. Those unable to upgrade immediately can disable password logins by setting PasswordAuthentication no. No reports of exploitation have been received so far.
The Hacker News

zaihua_news/3377.title: 🤖 OpenAI releases GPT-6 Cyber security model
paragraphs: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Cyber, calling it a major advance in security research, with stronger capabilities and better model alignment. The model powered the Linux kernel research announced yesterday, and security teams at companies including Mozilla, Palo Alto Networks, and Cisco are already using it.
The model is currently available only to select Daybreak Red customers. OpenAI says it will gradually expand access.
OpenAI(@OpenAI)

zaihua_news/3378.title: Google Releases Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash Video Model
paragraphs: Google has released Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, a video generation model from Google DeepMind. The company says it generates videos faster at 30% lower cost: create 360p or 720p drafts ($0.07 per second), then upscale them to 1080p or 4K.

Videos can be up to 15 seconds long, with a choice of 3 to 15 seconds. The model supports conversational, iterative changes to backgrounds, subjects, and lighting; more natural multi-speaker audio and lip sync; and more controlled camera movement with fewer jump cuts.
Google(@Google)

zaihua_news/3379.title: Claude connects to bank accounts and launches personal finance features
paragraphs: Anthropic is rolling out personal finance features for Claude, letting users connect their bank and credit card accounts through Plaid. Users can ask where their money went this month, and Claude will generate a spending overview by category, such as rent and utilities, shopping, and dining.

The feature is read-only. Claude can’t transfer money, manage finances, or provide investment advice, but it can view account balances, credit limits, and up to two years of transaction history. Testing begins this week for Pro, Max, and Ultra subscribers in the U.S.
The Verge

zaihua_news/3380.title: India aims to develop its own GPU chip within 24 months
paragraphs: India’s Secretary of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, S. Krishnan, said on November 4 that the country plans to develop a homegrown GPU chip in about 24 months under “India Semiconductor Mission 2.0.” He described AI as a new opportunity for the IT industry, comparable to the Y2K era.

He did not disclose the manufacturer or chip supplier. India also plans to bring its RISC-V-based SHAKTI and VEGA processors to market. India’s semiconductor market is currently worth about $50 billion and is expected to approach $100 billion by 2030.
Tom's Hardware

zaihua_news/3381.title: 🤖 OpenAI Advertisers top 100,000
paragraphs: Since OpenAI launched ads in February 2026, ChatGPT has attracted over 100,000 advertisers. Last week, Google expanded ads in AI Mode to 10 countries outside the US. Anthropic still maintains that Claude won’t run ads, and its IPO filing made no mention of ad revenue.
Startup Koah serves ads across more than 200 apps, with just one-tenth as many clients as OpenAI. It says ads involving AI have double the click-through rate, averaging around 3% overall.
WIRED

zaihua_news/3382.title: 🍏 Apple surveys iPhone Duo buyers about the crease and camera
paragraphs: Apple is emailing some iPhone Duo buyers a survey asking whether the crease is noticeable, about the size of the outer display when the phone is closed, whether the under-display camera is distracting, and about image quality. The final question is open-ended, asking buyers what features they would like added or changed.

The Duo has a 5.4-inch outer display, and its 4-megapixel under-display camera is one of the main complaints in reviews. The survey doesn’t ask about Touch ID, the experience with apps that aren’t optimized, or screen cracks reported by some users.
MacRumors

zaihua_news/3383.title: China Mobile launches initiative to jointly develop 6G network applications
paragraphs: On November 6, the 2026 China Mobile Global Partners Conference was held in Guangzhou. At the event, China Mobile’s chief engineer and an academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering announced the “China Mobile Initiative for Jointly Developing 6G Network Applications.” The initiative aims to work with industry partners to explore the value of 6G, drive innovation in network technology, and jointly incubate new 6G network products and business models.

Speakers noted that commercial 6G service is less than 30 months away. Applications must drive development to unlock the network’s value sooner, and the entire industry chain needs to contribute resources including technology, funding, and talent.
C114 Communications Network

zaihua_news/3384.title: 🌙Moonshot AI is reportedly looking to rent Nvidia Blackwell computing power in Europe
paragraphs: Sources say Moonshot AI is in talks to rent Nvidia Blackwell computing power from a European neocloud data center, on a scale of more than 8,000 GPUs, primarily for inference and also for training. The White House said in July that the company had accessed Blackwell chips through facilities in Thailand.

US export controls bar Blackwell imports into China, and remote access through overseas cloud services is seen as a workaround. One proposal would require Moonshot AI to pay 30% to 50% more upfront than non-Chinese buyers.
CNBC

zaihua_news/3385.title: Baidu open-sources ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base, its foundational model
paragraphs: Baidu has officially open-sourced its latest foundational model, ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base. The model uses a MoE architecture, with 280 billion total parameters and 14 billion parameters activated per token. It was pretrained on 33.5 trillion tokens, with a maximum pretraining context length of 128K. Fine-tuning and inference support context lengths of up to 1 million tokens.
Focused on efficiency, the model has been systematically optimized across its attention mechanism, expert routing, and training objectives to improve resource utilization.
新华网

zaihua_news/3386.title: National Radio and Television Administration reiterates support for live-action micro-dramas and tighter rules for AI dramas
paragraphs: A relevant official at the National Radio and Television Administration reiterated on November 5 that the micro-drama sector should support live-action productions and regulate AI dramas. The official also called on platforms to ensure that every title aired is reviewed, with all content checked by human reviewers, improve their algorithms, and continue cracking down on AI content laundering, pirated remakes, and unauthorized use of people’s likenesses and voices.

The official said AI should assist in producing high-quality content, while live-action productions should remain the mainstay of micro-dramas. Regulating AI dramas requires upholding copyright and ethical standards. Data released by the National Radio and Television Administration shows that 430,000 micro-dramas were released in the first eight months of this year, of which AI dramas accounted for more than 90%.
IT Home

zaihua_news/3387.title: Six departments issue measures to accelerate the adoption of frontier technologies such as embodied intelligence in elder care
paragraphs: On November 4, the Ministry of Civil Affairs and five other departments issued Several Measures to Foster Diverse Scenarios and Promote Consumer Spending on Age-Friendly Products. The measures call for using major national science and technology projects to accelerate the application of frontier technologies—including embodied intelligence, large language models, brain-computer interfaces and exoskeletons—in elder care, and to develop and upgrade intelligent devices for long-term care, rehabilitation and companionship.
The measures also encourage faster deployment of intelligent elder care robots, promote rental models such as “rent-to-own,” and foster consumer venues such as senior malls and silver-age markets.
财联社

zaihua_news/3388.title: Yangtze Memory’s New Factory Aims for Up to 70% Domestic Equipment
paragraphs: China’s largest flash memory chipmaker, Yangtze Memory, plans to build its fourth factory in Wuhan. Construction is expected to begin in 2027, with a goal of raising the share of equipment purchased domestically to at least 60%, and as high as 70%, up from more than 50% at its third factory. The new facility will produce advanced NAND flash with more than 300 layers, primarily to meet demand for data centers and AI storage.

U.S. export controls are accelerating Yangtze Memory’s shift to domestic equipment. Cleaning, polishing and etching tools are expected to see the biggest gains. However, the company still relies on overseas suppliers for advanced equipment such as lithography and inspection tools. Yangtze Memory now holds 38.5% of China’s NAND market, overtaking Samsung. Once all three planned new factories are fully operational, its overall capacity could double.
Reuters

zaihua_news/3389.title: Doubao Work Personal removes the 5-hour usage limit
paragraphs: Starting November 6, Doubao Work Personal users will no longer be subject to the 5-hour usage limit. Personal users can arrange their usage freely within their weekly quota. Weekly quotas and other usage rules remain subject to the applicable plan. Users can check their remaining quota and detailed rules under “Settings – Subscription and Quota Management.”

Doubao Work is an AI product designed for productivity. It can break down tasks based on their goals and use tools to carry out research and analysis, create content, process data, build applications, and more.
IT之家

zaihua_news/3390.title: US Democrats Plan Investigations into Apple, Meta and Musk-Owned Companies
paragraphs: U.S. Democrats are preparing a new round of congressional investigations into major companies, with Apple, Meta and Musk-owned companies among the early targets. The investigations may focus on Apple hosting a tracking app used by immigration enforcement, Meta requiring local governments to sign nondisclosure agreements for data center projects, and Trump using Musk-owned AI chatbot Grok to plan military operations.

People familiar with the matter said Democrats are ramping up preparations after winning majorities in the House and Senate. Apple, Meta, X and Musk did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

The Washington Post
Apple
Demand documents related to donations to Trump’s White House ballroom project, potentially under threat of a subpoena; continue investigating its decision to remove an ICE tracking app from the App Store under pressure from the Trump administration.

Meta
Demand documents related to ballroom donations; investigate nondisclosure agreements (NDAs) with local governments for data center projects and require details on electricity and water usage.

Alphabet / Google
Demand documents related to ballroom donations; investigate data center NDAs; require reports on AI model safety incidents within 48 hours of discovery.

Amazon
Demand documents related to ballroom donations; investigate data center NDAs.

Nvidia
Demand documents related to ballroom donations; Republican lawmakers have asked CEO Jensen Huang to give a closed-door congressional briefing on November 18 about his interactions with Alice Huang, who is accused of being a Chinese intelligence agent, and the company’s anti-espionage safeguards.

Microsoft
Demand documents related to ballroom donations.

Oracle
Investigate data center NDAs with local governments.

OpenAI
Require reports to Congress within 48 hours of discovering AI model “misalignment” or a safety incident; the CEO may be subpoenaed to testify.

Anthropic
Require reports to Congress within 48 hours of discovering an AI model safety incident; the CEO may be subpoenaed to testify.

Musk-owned companies (xAI, X, SpaceX, Tesla)
Investigate layoffs, contract cancellations and data use during Musk’s leadership of DOGE; review federal contracts and potential conflicts of interest; require preservation of official records of Trump’s conversations with Grok; potentially review xAI’s federal contracts and AI safety issues.

These measures are currently mostly at the stage of sending letters demanding information and preparing subpoenas and hearings. They are part of an oversight plan Democrats are advancing after the midterm elections.

zaihua_news/3391.title: 🚘 Tesla to gradually phase out Cybertruck production by mid-next year
paragraphs: Tesla CEO Elon Musk said in a post on X Friday that the company will “gradually wind down” Cybertruck production at its Texas Gigafactory by mid-next year, making room to ramp up Cybercab production.

The factory is the only known site assembling Cybertrucks, and no mention was made of moving production elsewhere. Since its 2023 launch, deliveries are estimated to have peaked at around 70,000, far below earlier forecasts of 250,000 annual sales.
The Verge

zaihua_news/3392.title: PepsiCo Renews Beverage Supply Agreement with KFC Across Eight Countries
paragraphs: PepsiCo announced today that it has renewed its beverage supply partnership with KFC across eight international markets: Australia, India, the UK, Spain, Germany, France, the Netherlands, and Belgium. The renewal extends a decades-long partnership between the two companies, whose operations now span markets across the Middle East, Europe, Asia Pacific, and Latin America. The financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
36kr

zaihua_news/3393.title: 📱 The EU accuses TikTok’s recommendation algorithm of creating a “rabbit hole” effect
paragraphs: The European Commission has accused TikTok’s recommendation algorithm of creating a “rabbit hole” effect, in violation of the Digital Services Act. The Commission says TikTok has failed to take effective measures to address the risks and is demanding changes to its “For You” algorithm to rely more on users’ explicit preferences, improve control options, and test the algorithm regularly.

If the issue is not resolved, parent company ByteDance could face a fine next year of up to 6% of its global annual revenue. The EU says repeatedly pushing similar content could affect mental health. The accusation is part of a broader investigation.
CNBC

zaihua_news/3394.title: Taobao’s MNN team open-sources a 0.3B on-device model
paragraphs: On November 6, Taobao’s MNN team open-sourced MNN-Pocket-0.3B, an on-device model with around 300 million parameters. It runs fully offline on the iPhone 18 Pro, averaging about 350 tokens/s during decoding. The INT4 deployment files are just 173 MB.

The team targeted peak memory usage below 300 MB and decoding speeds above 200 tokens/s. The final model uses a 28-layer architecture, and its vocabulary was trimmed from 151K to 64K. The team open-sourced several versions for pretraining, post-training, and on-device deployment.
IT Home

zaihua_news/3395.title: 🍏 Researcher discovers around 100,000 words hidden from Apple Keyboard recommendations
paragraphs: Independent researcher Derik Kauffman discovered around 100,000 entries that the iPhone keyboard on Apple systems will not recommend, including political phrases such as “Dictator Trump” and “Sleepy Joe.” These restrictions do not prevent users from typing the words manually, but block them from autocomplete and swipe typing.

Apple says the keyboard is designed to avoid recommending offensive language, but has not explained why political terms were included. David Greene of the Electronic Frontier Foundation says the list should not be secret and that users should be informed and allowed to modify it.
The Next Web

zaihua_news/3396.title: ✈️ Telegram 13.2 supports HTML messages that run in chats
paragraphs: Telegram’s Android, iOS, and macOS apps have been updated to version 13.2, and Desktop to version 7.4. Developers can use HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to create interactive messages that run directly in chats without opening a Mini App, such as mini-games with touch controls and saved progress.

Topics in groups and bots now support a “sidebar” layout, with the topic list opening from the right side of the screen. This layout is enabled automatically in channel direct messages and “Saved Messages.”
Tginfo  | Google Play | App Store

zaihua_news/3397.title: 🍏 Rumor: Apple may remove the iPhone’s dedicated Action button next year
paragraphs: Leaker Instant Digital says Apple will remove the dedicated Action button from new iPhones launching in the second half of 2027, merging its functions into the Camera Control button: press once to open the camera, or press and hold to trigger the action previously assigned to the Action button.

The Camera Control button debuted with the iPhone 16 and received mixed reviews. Pressing and holding it was originally used for Visual Intelligence, but iOS 27 has integrated that feature into the Camera app as a Siri mode.
MacRumors

zaihua_news/3398.title: The U.S. Department of Justice’s “Superintelligence Task Force” is officially operational
paragraphs: The U.S. Department of Justice announced that the Superintelligence Task Force (SINTF) is now operational. Established under a memo signed by Trump on October 13 and led by the Director of National Intelligence, the task force is responsible for maintaining U.S. leadership in AI and countering foreign AI “abuses.”

The task force will coordinate the Justice Department’s criminal and civil AI cases and help block legislative proposals for “burdensome regulation.” Pentagon CTO Emil Michael said details of AI regulation will be announced later this month.
Theregister

zaihua_news/3399.title: TRAE accounts will be upgraded to Doubao Feishu accounts on November 18
paragraphs: TRAE announced that, starting November 18, 2026, personal accounts on TRAE CN will be automatically upgraded to Doubao Feishu accounts. Enterprise customers are not affected. Code, projects, history, membership benefits, and all types of credits will be retained.

After the upgrade, the same account can be used to sign in to Doubao App, Feishu, PICO, Volcano Engine, Doubao Input Method, and other products. Users who do not accept the upgrade must contact customer service or close their account themselves before November 18.
Official documentation

zaihua_news/3400.title: 🤖 Anthropic plans to launch its IPO roadshow next week, targeting a listing during the week of November 16
paragraphs: People familiar with the matter said Anthropic plans to begin its IPO roadshow next week, pitching potential investors, and aims to go public during the week of November 16, before the U.S. Thanksgiving holiday.

The roadshow comes after two weeks of sharp volatility in tech stocks. The company had been expected to raise more than $80 billion at a $1.5 trillion valuation, but recent concerns about AI stocks and spending could lead it to seek a lower valuation.
The Information | Sina.com

zaihua_news/3401.title: 📱 Microsoft is gradually ending its agreement to rent AI computing capacity from Oracle
paragraphs: Microsoft is gradually winding down its agreement to rent AI computing capacity from Oracle, having declined to renew contracts in recent months. Oracle shares briefly fell about 3%. People familiar with the matter said Oracle’s hardware uses an older generation of Nvidia chips that no longer meets Microsoft’s requirements.

The agreement was announced in 2023 to support the AI version of Bing Search. Oracle said demand for AI infrastructure remains strong. In September, it renewed a GPU contract signed four years ago at a price 20% higher than the original. Microsoft declined to comment.
Bloomberg

zaihua_news/3402.title: 🍏 Apple says more than 100,000 apps support iPhone Duo
paragraphs: Apple said that two weeks after iPhone Duo went on sale, more than 100,000 apps had been built for it on the App Store, with thousands of optimized apps launching every day. Apps including Microsoft Office, Zoom and YouTube have recently been updated to support the device. App Store pages for apps optimized for iPhone Duo will also display a dedicated “Made for iPhone Duo” badge.

Susan Prescott, Apple’s vice president of Worldwide Developer Relations, said thousands of developers had attended workshops held in 19 cities over the past month, and more than 2,000 people worldwide had taken part in over 50 in-person events.
9To5Mac

zaihua_news/3403.title: 🤖Apple OS 27.3 contains a marker for China’s version of Siri AI features
paragraphs: Apple is moving forward with bringing Siri AI to China. A feature flag for mainland China has appeared in Apple OS 27.3 IntelligenceFlow siriAIInChinaMainland  and is currently disabled.
The flag is read by Siri AI features in mainland China and is required for devices in China to be eligible for Siri AI, but this flag alone isn’t enough.
pdfu(@itspdfu)

zaihua_news/3404.title: Turkey Uses AI to Recover 100 Lost Artifacts from the U.S.
paragraphs: Turkey’s Culture Ministry has put around 200 artifacts recovered from the United States on display at the Istanbul Archaeological Museums. Highlights include bronze statues from the ancient city of Boubon, looted in the 1960s, and 44 ceramic architectural plaques dating from 700 to 480 BCE.

The recovery effort used lead isotope analysis, comparisons of mold shapes, and TraceART, an AI platform launched in 2025 that scans auction sites and social media worldwide. Since 1980, Turkey has recovered more than 26,700 artifacts.
ARTnews

zaihua_news/3405.title: TrendForce: Refurbished memory penetration in mobile phones may reach 9% next year
paragraphs: TrendForce expects refurbished memory penetration in the mobile phone market to rise from around 3%–4% in 2026 to 7%–9% in 2027. Continued increases in memory contract prices are prompting phone brands to use lower-cost refurbished memory in entry-level and budget models. For now, it is mainly used in 4G phones priced below 1,299 yuan.
TrendForce notes that uncertainty around the sourcing and quality consistency of refurbished memory could affect product reliability, shorten device lifespans, and increase after-sales costs.
TrendForce

zaihua_news/3406.title: 马斯克: Optimus robots may only be available for rent, not for sale
paragraphs: 马斯克 said at the 33rd Baron Investment Conference in New York that Tesla’s Optimus robots may only be available for rent, though rental prices and the work they can perform have not been disclosed. Each unit is expected to initially cost about $30,000, potentially dropping to $20,000. He also said they are five times as productive as an average person.

Early production of Optimus began at the Fremont factory this October, with planned annual capacity of 1 million units. However, it will take at least another year to reach full production speed, and external deliveries are planned for around the end of 2027.
IT Home

zaihua_news/3407.title: DeepSeek Web and API Services Partially Disrupted; Fix Implemented
paragraphs: On November 7, DeepSeek experienced a partial outage affecting the V4 Pro API, V4.1 Flash API, chat, and search services. The company has implemented a fix and is monitoring the services to confirm it has worked.
This is DeepSeek’s second outage in a week. The current outage has lasted around 30 minutes.
status.deepseek.com

zaihua_news/3408.title: Claude Code accused of potentially leaking email addresses while searching the web
paragraphs: A developer complained that Claude Code had filled in the user’s login email address in web requests and sent them without permission, causing them to receive large numbers of scam emails every day.

An Anthropic engineer said the login email had previously been added to the model’s context to address Claude incorrectly filling in authors’ names. The issue was reported as early as July this year, with email addresses sent to Wikipedia, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, and others. Version 2.1.317 added a block, but it can be bypassed with a Python script. The company plans to remove login email addresses from the context in the next release.
GitHub

zaihua_news/2970.title: 📱 Spotify is cracking down on Family plan sharing, requiring in-person scans of dynamic QR codes
paragraphs: Flower Community's assistant

Spotify is tightening scrutiny of family plan sharing, requiring members and the account manager to complete an in-person dynamic QR code address scan; those who fail must verify within 7 days, otherwise they will be downgraded to the free plan and barred from joining others' Family or Duo plans for 12 months.

The QR code refreshes every few seconds, making screenshots unusable; some users have switched to screen sharing to scan the code across multiple devices to bypass it. Spotify tested GPS checks in 2018 and updated its terms in 2019 to require periodic location verification.

zaihua_news/2999.title: Use AMD and you can't attend! Nvidia issues a ban on small cloud providers: use a rival chip and don't come
paragraphs: Nvidia recently rejected several emerging cloud service providers from attending the upcoming GTC conference in Berlin. The reason for rejection was not that they failed to meet technical standards, but that these providers had introduced rival chips such as AMD GPUs and Google TPUs into their own cloud platforms. Nvidia has not yet publicly commented on the incident. Nvidia is a chip supplier and also a major investor in emerging cloud providers such as CoreWeave and Nebius; it has made a strategic investment of $2 billion in each and also provided revenue backstops for their compute leasing. Many emerging cloud providers with limited scale do not dare to publicly use Nvidia's rival products, fearing that their priority GPU supply, financing, and IPO plans will be affected. This restriction does not apply to hyperscale cloud providers with sufficient purchasing volume and in-house chip capabilities.

zaihua_news/3001.title: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro launches on WorkBuddy
paragraphs: Xiaomi Technology announced that Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro is officially available on WorkBuddy. The model scored 46 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, ranking first among open-source models globally. It supports a 1M ultra-long context, multi-agent division of labor and collaboration, and full-modal joint understanding of images, video, audio, and text.
It targets long-horizon workflows such as long-running task hosting, deep research, design drafting, document work, and mini-tool development, and is now available for public trial.
Xiaomi Technology

zaihua_news/3002.title: Rumor claims Nvidia RTX 6060 may be delayed to 2029
paragraphs: Leaker Kepler_L2 says Nvidia's next-generation mainstream graphics card, the RTX 6060, could be delayed until as late as 2029, with memory supply shortages being one reason.

The card's performance may fall short of the Sony PS6, which is expected to launch earlier, but accurate comparisons are not yet possible. The leak also mentions that the RTX 60 series is expected to launch in 2028, and the previously rumored RTX 50 Super series may also be delayed due to memory supply shortages.
TechSpot

zaihua_news/3003.title: Flower Community Assistant  Smart TV users use AI coding assistants to remove homepage ads
paragraphs: Some smart TV users have begun using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code to remove TV homepage ads and bloatware. A developer said on 10/17 that he used one to connect to a Xiaomi TV, delete 25 packages, and bypass startup ads to go straight to Netflix.

These efforts feed into the open-source project CleanYourTV. TiVo says more than one-third of respondents complain about excessive homepage ads; using it requires a computer running Claude Code and only supports Android TV and Google TV.
Mashable

zaihua_news/3008.title: OpenAI API launches 12-hour prompt caching
paragraphs: OpenAI announces that the API now supports 12-hour prompt caching. Persistent agents (such as dots) can reuse shared instructions, tools, and context throughout the day; even when requests are hours apart, they are still billed at the lower cached input rate.
In addition, logged-in users of Codex and Work get permanent caching: returning to an old conversation or continuing after pausing for several hours incurs no penalty, and cache hits are guaranteed.
OpenAI Developers(@OpenAIDevs) | Tibo(@thsottiaux)

zaihua_news/3009.title: Little assistant in the Flower CommunitySpaceX and Tesla Boards Set Up Special Committees to Review Merger
paragraphs: The boards of SpaceX and Tesla have each established a special committee made up of independent directors to review a possible merger. Musk said the committees were set up at shareholders' request and that he will not take part in discussions due to a conflict of interest; the two sides have not yet reached agreement on transaction terms.

Musk supports the merger idea but said the deal is not a sure thing and will ultimately require shareholder support. A shareholder vote at SpaceX would be relatively easy to win, while Tesla would need the approval of 50% of all shareholders.
TechCrunch

zaihua_news/3010.title: People's Daily Sharp Commentary: Tesla can "fly" — so does that mean we've been left behind?
paragraphs: Recently, Tesla's release of a "flying car" sparked heated discussion. What's needed now is clear-headed composure. There's no need to belittle ourselves, and we certainly shouldn't dismiss the solid foundation China's new energy vehicle industry has built just because of a flashy new demonstration.

Tesla's "flight" this time is more like a polished concept show, while what Chinese automakers hold in their hands is a set of systematic, hard-earned capabilities. It can be said that China's automotive innovation is a multi-dimensional breakthrough, a flourishing of diverse and deep cultivation, and a progression of real-world results. Momentary flashiness may catch the eye, but pragmatic implementation is what enables steady, long-term progress. Avoid falling into "binary" thinking — either putting something on a pedestal or trampling it into the ground.
People's Daily Online

zaihua_news/3011.title: UK regulator requires Apple to open up iPhone NFC payments
paragraphs: The UK Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) has proposed measures requiring Apple to open up iPhone NFC and Wallet access to the international general-purpose contactless payment standard and to significantly reduce fees, saying its rules hinder innovation among UK fintech firms.

The CMA said payments in the UK 39% are already contactless and Apple Wallet is the most popular, yet no company has launched a competing product; the consultation period runs until 2026 year 11 month 17 day. Apple opposes the move, saying existing arrangements already allow developers to securely offer contactless transactions within apps.
Engadget

zaihua_news/3012.title: In the Huashe Community assistant , PHP Core has been exposed to high-risk RCE vulnerabilities, and the official release is scheduled for security updates on 10 month 21 day 22:00 (UTC+8).
paragraphs: The official PHP team announced the release of patches to fix two high-risk remote code execution vulnerabilities affecting its core interpreter (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, CVSS 9.2). The affected scope covers all historical and modern versions since PHP 5.4, including PHP 5.x, 7.x, 8.0 through 8.5 and other branches, and attacks can be triggered before business framework code execution.

Official fixes are provided only for supported branches (PHP 8.2, 8.3, 8.4, 8.5); end-of-life (EOL) versions cannot obtain official patches and must immediately restrict public network access or implement network isolation to prevent exploitation attacks.
sansec

At Huahua Community’s little assistant
AMD FSR 4.1 expands support to RX 6000 graphics cards and Xbox, with Vulkan API support coming
paragraphs: AMD is expanding FSR Upscaling 4.1 to RX 6000 series graphics cards, Ryzen AI Max processors, Ryzen AI 9 laptops, and handhelds such as the Z2 Extreme. Support for Xbox Series X|S is coming soon.

The feature is being released with the Adrenalin 26.10.1 driver, offering a clear image quality improvement over FSR 3.1. When FSR 4 first launched in 2025, it supported only the RX 9000 series. In 2026, it expanded to the RX 7 series in 7000.
